name: python-ab-test
title: A/B Test Statistics
blurb: A/B tests where the p-value is not the whole story. A two-proportion test with a Wilson interval per arm, a difference interval and a relative lift that says what it cannot see; a sample-ratio-mismatch check that catches a broken assignment before anybody reads the lift; and a peeking simulation that MEASURES how far a 5% test drifts when somebody checks the dashboard every day (18.9% against a flat line, 6.7% under a spending boundary).
default_description: A/B test maths you can defend: fixed-horizon tests, a peeking simulation that shows the false-positive cost, a spending boundary, and an SRM gate.
